title: Normalize Docker image references
desc: A deployment pipeline collects every container image used across your services. Before it can pin them, it needs every reference in one canonical form, the same way Docker expands them. **Input (stdin)** One image reference per line. Trim spaces around each line. Ignore blank lines and lines that start with `#`. **Normalization rules** 1. **Tag:** if the last `:` in the reference comes after the last `/`, everything after that `:` is the tag. Otherwise the tag is `latest`. 2. **Registry:** split the rest on `/`. If there are at least two parts and the first part contains a `.` or a `:`, or is exactly `localhost`, that first part is the registry. Otherwise the registry is `docker.io`. 3. **Official images:** if the registry is `docker.io` and only one path part is left, put `library/` in front of it. 4. Print `registry/path:tag`. **Validation** (use full-string matches) - Registry: `[a-z0-9]+([.-][a-z0-9]+)*(:[0-9]+)?` - Every path part: `[a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*` (there must be at least one path part) - Tag: `[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}` If any check fails, print `INVALID ` followed by the trimmed original line. **Output (stdout)** One line per reference, in input order, then a final summary line: `valid <count> invalid <count>`. **Example** Input (this is what the Run button feeds): Output: Submit feeds a different list and several extra hidden lists (including edge cases), so printing the sample output will not pass.
